title: Human-caused methane emissions by source

source.name: Global Methane Assessment: Benefits and Costs of Mitigating Methane Emissions
source.publisher: United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) and Climate and Clean Air Coalition (CCAC)

notes: Share of human-caused (anthropogenic) methane emissions by sector. Livestock (manure + enteric fermentation) 32%, fossil fuels 35%, waste 20%, rice cultivation 8%; remainder (~5%) is biomass burning and other sources, not itemized here.
